title: geodesic-anomaly-test: Information-geometric hypothesis testing on the categorical statistical manifold
description: Reference implementation, simulations, and real-data (NSL-KDD) experiment for the geodesic (Fisher-Rao) test statistic on the categorical statistical manifold and its use for anomaly detection in decision-support systems. Reproduces every figure, table, and reported statistic in the accompanying article.
